meta.parties: Salee Et Al. v. Natchia Et Al

rules.statement: A deed of transfer executed before the final decree in a partition action is not necessarily invalid under section 17 of Ordinance No. 10 of 1863 if it deals with undivided interests and all parties to the partition action are involved.
